review.given_information: Target-floor labelled scans at all legal non-Query positions and original Query RSS.
review.learning_object: Existing deterministic 3-WKNN with its original missing-value and weighting rule.
review.partition: Exclude every scan at each Query coordinate before applying the original support-acquisition restriction.
review.deployment: WKNN receives an empty H, legal labelled S, the unchanged AP axis and Query RSS. Query coordinates remain in partitioning and scoring.
review.parameters: Missing RSS -110, RMS over S-observed APs, stable nearest3, inverse distance floor1e-8 and S-derived outward2m bounds.
review.acquisition: Use the original support_acquisition when defined. Use the original unseparated acquisition pool otherwise.
review.counterexamples: Zero RSS distance uses the existing floor. Dataset scan order preserves stable ties. Empty context and absent APs follow the existing error behavior.
review.interpretation: This measured reference varies both calibration positions and scans per position. Its cost is reported directly.
review.falsifiable_comparison: Compare the same Query units and position-balanced errors. More calibration can still worsen this fixed WKNN rule.
review.uncertainty: Repeated draws share recorded positions. This empirical reference carries no theoretical optimum claim.
